API base for a tenant is /ragstack/<tenant>/api/v1/. Machine-readable list: /ragstack/tenants.

  • Vaxpipe UI :5174 open proxied

    Vite dev server, ~/Development/VaxpipeApp/ui, mounted the same way a tenant UI is: served through the gateway with the prefix preserved, so it works from anywhere this page does. Its /api/v1 calls reach GoWe through the same route; sign in to use them.

  • Grafana :3001 open proxied

    Dashboards, proxied through the gateway. Runs with serve_from_sub_path, so it emits its own prefixed URLs and needs no rewriting here. Sign-in is live.

  • GoWe :8091 open health proxied

    Workflow engine (v0.19.0), mounted under its own base path like a tenant UI. It dual-mounts, so workers and CLI clients still reach it directly on :8091. The :8081 / :8444 listener still serves it at a root as a fallback and is due to be retired.

/ragstack/services/<name> gives each of these a stable URL. Entries tagged proxied are served through the gateway end to end, exactly like the Tenants tab. Entries tagged on-campus only redirect to the service's own address instead, so following one needs network access to this host — that is a limitation of the service, not of the gateway. Machine-readable: /ragstack/services.

The Vaxpipe BV-BRC app has no port and will not get one: BV-BRC apps are batch jobs the scheduler runs on an allocated node, not services. Only the dev UI and the workflow engine listen.
